notes.title: Vilomah - Disrate's New Game!
notes.content:
Hello,

Vilomah, a retro Survival Horror Game, has now been released onto Steam! It's currently 10% off to celebrates it's launch!

What is Vilomah?

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42595122/c18ef7404394de8e245833730f08179f8c19a381.png[/img]

[i][b]The Story[/b][/i]

Play as Jake, a teenager working the late shift in "Sal's Pizzeria" - until he's called to deliver to the HOUSE OF NIGHTMARES! Avoid this TERRIFYING KILLER in an abandoned Farm House, filled with Challenging Puzzles, Deadly Traps and Hidden Secrets!


[i][b]The Hag[/b][/i]

Stay quiet and out of sight! She can sense when you're nearby, using her heightened senses... use your Stealth Bar to stay hidden, out of light and using cover to your advantage - otherwise she might just CATCH YOU!

Try to survive and escape in this fully explorable house - search in drawers for items, keys and more! Try and find out what happened here... but be careful - the hag is always watching your every move!

[i][b]Key Features:[/b][/i]

Terrifying AI
Retro Inventory
Challenging Puzzles
Tense Stealth Mechanics
Outstanding Sound Design
Classic PS1 Visuals
Togglable VHS Effects
Horrifying Original Soundtrack
Frightening Survival Horror
1+ Hour Gameplay
Lots of Hidden Secrets!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2123420/Vilomah/]Make sure to check it out now![/url]

- Max

Thanks :)
